1.word_for_word: अष्ट-षष्टितमे साम्बे निरुद्धे कौरवैर् युधि — In the sixty-eighth Samba was defeated by the Kauravas in battle; तद् विमोक्षाय रामेण गजाह्नय-विकर्षणम् — That was the pull of the elephant killed by Rama to free him; राम-चरित्रान्तरं निरूपयितुम् आह---दुर्योधन-सुताम् इति । — To describe the difference in the character of Rama, he says that she is the daughter of Duryodhana.; समितिञ्-जयः सङ्ग्राम-जित् ॥१-२॥ — The victory of the committee is the victory of the battle.1-2
1.translation: In the sixty-eighth Samba was defeated by the Kauravas in battle That was the pull of the elephant killed by Rama to free him To describe the difference in the character of Rama, he says that she is the daughter of Duryodhana. The victory of the committee is the victory of the battle.1-2

3.word_for_word: यान्ति यास्यन्ति । — They’re going to go.; प्राणा इन्द्रियाणीव । — Prana is like the senses.; सुसंयताः प्राणायामादिभिर् दमिताः ॥४॥ — They were well controlled and restrained by pranayama and other means.
3.translation: They’re going to go. Prana is like the senses. They were well controlled and restrained by pranayama and other means.

5.word_for_word: कुरु-वृद्धो भीष्मः, तेन अनुमोदितास् तत्-सहिताः षड् एत इत्य् अर्थः ॥५-६॥ — This means that Bhishma, the elder of the Kurus, and these six with him were approved by him.
5.translation: This means that Bhishma, the elder of the Kurus, and these six with him were approved by him.

7.word_for_word: कर्णो\ऽग्र गीर् येषां ते ॥७॥ — They have the tip of their ears.
7.translation: They have the tip of their ears.

8.word_for_word: नामृष्यत् असहत् अचिन्त्यस्य भगवतो\ऽर्भो\ऽर्भकः । — The infant could not bear the inconceivable Lord’s infancy.; अचिन्त्यश् चासाव् अर्भश् चेति वा ॥८-९॥ — or Achintya and Asav and Arbha.8-9
8.translation: The infant could not bear the inconceivable Lord’s infancy. or Achintya and Asav and Arbha.8-9

9.word_for_word: तत्-प्रपञ्चयति चतुभिर् इति चतुर्भिश् चतुर इत्य् अत्र वीप्सानुसन्धेया । — That-he explains it by four, and by four, and by four, is to be followed here by the wish.; तत्-कर्म ते संमानितवन्तः ॥९-११॥ — They honored that action.9-1
9.translation: That-he explains it by four, and by four, and by four, is to be followed here by the wish. They honored that action.9-1

12.word_for_word: स्वस्य दुर्योधनस्य कन्यां च नीत्वेति ॥१२-१३॥ — and taking his daughter Duryodhana (12-13).

14.word_for_word: यतः कलिं नैच्छेदतः सान्त्वयित्वा जगामेति ॥१४-१५॥ — Because he did not wish to become Kali, he consoled him and went away (14-15).
14.translation: Because he did not wish to become Kali, he consoled him and went away (14-15).

16.word_for_word: धृतराष्ट्रं प्रति बुभुत्सयेति अभिप्राय-जिज्ञासयेत्य् अर्थः ॥१६॥ — This means that he should inquire about his intention to understand Dhritarashtra.
16.translation: This means that he should inquire about his intention to understand Dhritarashtra.

17.word_for_word: विधिवद् अभिवन्द्य ॥१७॥ — offering obeisances in the manner prescribed.
17.translation: offering obeisances in the manner prescribed.

18.word_for_word: तम् उद्धवम् अर्चयित्वा सत्कृत्य । — After worshiping and honoring him, Uddhava.; मङ्गल-पाणय उपायन-हस्ताः ॥१८॥ — Holding auspicious gifts in your hands.
18.translation: After worshiping and honoring him, Uddhava. Holding auspicious gifts in your hands.

19.word_for_word: वृद्धा अपि प्रणेमुः ॥१९-२१॥ — Even the old men bowed down.19-2
19.translation: Even the old men bowed down.19-2

22.word_for_word: यद् यूयम् इत्य् उग्रसेन-वाक्यम् । — That’s what Ugrasena said.; मृष्ये सहे । — I’ll bear it.; अथाशु तम् आनीय समर्पयत इति शेषः ॥२२॥ — Then quickly bring him and offer him, the rest.
22.translation: That’s what Ugrasena said. I’ll bear it. Then quickly bring him and offer him, the rest.

23.word_for_word: वीर्यं प्रभावः शौर्यम् उत्साहो बलं सत्त्वं तैरुनद्धम् उच्छृखलम् । — Their prowess, influence, courage, enthusiasm, strength, strength, and strength are all chain-linked.; कथम् । — How is it.; आत्मनः शक्तेः समम् अनुरूपम् ॥२३॥ — equally in accordance with the power of the self.
23.translation: Their prowess, influence, courage, enthusiasm, strength, strength, and strength are all chain-linked. How is it. equally in accordance with the power of the self.

24.word_for_word: उपानत् पाद-रक्षा शिर आरोढुम् इच्छति इति हीना अस्मान् आज्ञापयन्तीत्य् अर्थः ॥२४॥ — This means that the devoid of shoes and foot protection want to climb on their heads and command us to do so.
24.translation: This means that the devoid of shoes and foot protection want to climb on their heads and command us to do so.

25.word_for_word: अस्यैव प्रपञ्च एत इति चतुर्भिः । — This is the universe of this very thing, in four ways.; यौनेन पृथाया विवाहेन ॥२५॥ — by sexual intercourse and by the marriage of Pritha.
25.translation: This is the universe of this very thing, in four ways. by sexual intercourse and by the marriage of Pritha.

26.word_for_word: किञ् च । — And what’s more.; चामर-व्यजने इति । — in the Chamar fan.; भुञ्जत्य् उपभुञ्जत इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that they eat and enjoy.; अस्मद् अपेक्षयास्माकम् अनाग्रहेण ॥२६॥ — Without prejudice to our expectations.
26.translation: And what’s more. in the Chamar fan. It means that they eat and enjoy. Without prejudice to our expectations.

27.word_for_word: अलम् इति । — Alam is the name.; अतः परं तान्य् अपहरिष्याम इत्य् अर्थः ॥२७॥ — This means that we will take them away from here onwards.
27.translation: Alam is the name. This means that we will take them away from here onwards.

28.word_for_word: अवरुधीत स्वीकुर्यात् । — Blocked and accepted.; उरणो मेषः ॥२८॥ — The lamb is the ram.
28.translation: Blocked and accepted. The lamb is the ram.

29.word_for_word: जन्मना बन्धुभिश् चोपलक्षितया श्रिया उन्नद्ध उत्कटो मदो येषां ते । — They are those whose pride is elevated by the beauty of their birth and by the recognition of their relatives.; दुर्वाच्यं परुषं वाक्यम् । — It’s a harsh word that’s hard to say.; असभ्या दुर्जनाः ॥३९॥ — They are rude and evil.
29.translation: They are those whose pride is elevated by the beauty of their birth and by the recognition of their relatives. It’s a harsh word that’s hard to say. They are rude and evil.

31.word_for_word: नाना-धनाभिजनादि-मदैर् उन्नधास् तेषां दण्ड एव प्रथमः प्रकर्षेण शमयतीति तथा । — They are raised by the pride of various wealth, family and other things, and their punishment is the first thing that appeases them.; यथा लगुडो दण्डः ॥३१-३२॥ — as the stick is a rod.31-3
31.translation: They are raised by the pride of various wealth, family and other things, and their punishment is the first thing that appeases them. as the stick is a rod.31-3

33.word_for_word: दुर्माषान् अवाच्य-शब्दान् ॥३३॥ — They made bad meat and unspeakable words.
33.translation: They made bad meat and unspeakable words.

34.word_for_word: दुर्भाषणम् अनुस्मरति षड्भिः, नोग्रसेन इति । — He remembers the bad speech by six, not by Ugrasena.; विभुर् आज्ञापयितुं समर्थः ॥३४॥ — The almighty is able to command.
34.translation: He remembers the bad speech by six, not by Ugrasena. The almighty is able to command.

35.word_for_word: अहो धृष्टा श्री-कृष्णम् अप्य् अधिक्षिपन्तीति कुपित आह---सु-धर्मेत्य् आदिभिस् त्रिभिः ॥३५-३६॥ — Oh, the arrogant ones are insulting even Sri Krishna, he angrily said, "It is good righteousness," and so on, with three others. 35-3
35.translation: Oh, the arrogant ones are insulting even Sri Krishna, he angrily said, "It is good righteousness," and so on, with three others. 35-3

37-38.word_for_word: मौल्य्-उत्तमैर् मौलि-युक्तैर् उत्तमाङ्गैः, उत्तमैर् मौलिभिर् इति वा । — Mauly-uttamai mauli-yuktai uttamaangai, or uttamai maulibhi.; उपासितानि तीर्थानि यैर् योगिभिस् तेषाम् अपि तीर्थम् ॥ — The holy places worshiped by the yogīs are also holy places.; यद् वा, उपासितं सर्वैः सेवितं तीर्थं गङ्गा तस्यास् तीर्थं तीर्थत्व-निमित्तम् । — Or rather, the Ganges is a holy place worshiped and served by all, and that is why it is a holy place.; किं च, ब्रह्मा भवः श्रीश् चाहम् अपि उद्वहेम । — What’s more, Brahma, Bhava, Sri and I will also carry it.; कथं भूता वयम् ? — How have we become?; यस्य कलाया अंशस्य कला अंशाः ॥३७-३८॥ — The arts of which are parts of the arts are parts of the arts.37-3
37-38.translation: Mauly-uttamai mauli-yuktai uttamaangai, or uttamai maulibhi. The holy places worshiped by the yogīs are also holy places. Or rather, the Ganges is a holy place worshiped and served by all, and that is why it is a holy place. What’s more, Brahma, Bhava, Sri and I will also carry it. How have we become? The arts of which are parts of the arts are parts of the arts.37-3

39-40.word_for_word: मत्तानाम् इव मद्यादिना । — Like drunks with alcohol and other things.; रूक्षाः परुषाः । — They are rough and harsh.; अनुशासिता स्वयं दण्ड-धरः सन् ॥३९-४०॥ — Disciplined himself, being the bearer of the rod.39-4
39-40.translation: Like drunks with alcohol and other things. They are rough and harsh. Disciplined himself, being the bearer of the rod.39-4

41.word_for_word: लाङ्गलाग्रेण दक्षिणतः प्राकार-मूले निस्वातेन । — With the tip of a stick on the right side, at the foot of the wall, there was a breeze.; उद्विदार्य उत्पाट्य ॥४१-४२॥ — tearing it apart and uprooting it.41-4
41.translation: With the tip of a stick on the right side, at the foot of the wall, there was a breeze. tearing it apart and uprooting it.41-4

43.word_for_word: जिजीविषव इत्य् अक्षराधिक्यं सोढव्यम् ॥४३॥ — Jijiviṣava, the excess of syllables, should be tolerated.
43.translation: Jijiviṣava, the excess of syllables, should be tolerated.

44.word_for_word: मूढानां प्रभावान् अभिज्ञानाम् । — I recognize the effects of fools.; अतिक्रमम् अपराधम् ॥४४-४५॥ — Transgression is a crime.44-4
44.translation: I recognize the effects of fools. Transgression is a crime.44-4

46.word_for_word: शेषे शयनं करोषि । — You’re going to bed in the rest.; शेष-पर्यङ्के परिशिष्यमाणो यः स च त्वम् एवेति वा ॥४६॥ — Or that you are the one who is lying on the rest of the bed
46.translation: You’re going to bed in the rest. Or that you are the one who is lying on the rest of the bed

47.word_for_word: अस्मासु कोपश् च तवायम् अनुचित एवेत्य् आहुः । — They say that your anger at us is unjustified.; कोपस्तु इति स्थिति-पालने तत्-परस्तात्-पर्यवान्-कोपः । — Anger, however, is the anger that follows in the maintenance of the position.; पाठान्तरे सम्बोधनम् ॥४७॥ — Address in another text.
47.translation: They say that your anger at us is unjustified. Anger, however, is the anger that follows in the maintenance of the position. Address in another text.

48.word_for_word: विश्वं कर्मं कृत्यं यस्य स त्वम् इति सम्बोधनम् ॥४८॥ — The universe is the action of the one whose action is to be done, and that is the address.
48.translation: The universe is the action of the one whose action is to be done, and that is the address.

49.word_for_word: वेपमानम् अयनं पुरं येषां तैः ॥४९॥ — They whose city is trembling with the moon.
49.translation: They whose city is trembling with the moon.

50.word_for_word: तुरङ्गमांश् च द्वादशायुतानि ॥५०-११॥ — and twelve thousand horses.50-1

52.word_for_word: सुहृद्भिः कौरवैः ॥५२॥ — with his friends the Kauravas.

53.word_for_word: मध्ये-सभायां सभा-मध्ये ॥५३-५४॥ — In the middle of the assembly, in the middle of the assembly.53-5
53.translation: In the middle of the assembly, in the middle of the assembly.53-5
